title: Dashboard-to-Deck Narrative Generator
description: Pick a sample dashboard, watch Claude write the executive readout, download a themed 7-slide PPTX. The other half of the BI workflow — turning visuals back into story.

resumeBullet.text: Built a Dashboard-to-Deck Narrative Generator on Next.js + Vercel — consumes finished BI dashboards across six business domains, streams an AI-authored executive readout with a 5-section structure (headline / movement / so-what / talking points / risks), and emits a themed 7-slide PPTX via pptxgenjs. Shares the streaming primitive + design system with the Dashboard Factory; together they close the loop on the BI workflow.

portfolioCard.problem: Once a BI engineer ships a dashboard, the analyst's real work begins: writing the executive readout. Pulling the headline insight, drafting the bullet narrative, formatting a PPTX that survives the Monday review. This is the part nobody outsources well — vendor narrative tools generate generic captions, manual writing eats hours per week, and the dashboard-to-deck handoff is where insight quality gets lost.
portfolioCard.approach: Three-step factory sharing its engine with Project 1. (1) Pick a sample dashboard from a curated library of six (RevOps, Marketing, Ops, Finance, HR, CX) — each a finished BI artifact with 5 KPIs + 3 charts + supporting rows. (2) Watch Claude stream the executive readout word-by-word, structured around 5 sections (Headline / What moved / So what / Talking points / Risks + caveats) that map 1:1 to slides. (3) Download a 7-slide PPTX themed to the dashboard's accent color, generated server-side by pptxgenjs and served as a static asset (built at compile time, cached at the CDN edge with Cache-Control: immutable). Streaming primitive (@rishi/ai-core/replayFixture) + AiNarrativeBlock + Dialog primitive all shared with Project 1 — zero code duplication.
portfolioCard.impact: Analyst readout-writing time drops from hours to minutes. Narrative quality stays consistent because the hand-curated narrative fixtures share the AI voice with Project 1's profiling fixtures. The downloaded PPTX is themed (Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono typography, per-dashboard accent color, design-system palette) so the deck matches the company's brand out of the box — no separate template wrangling. Three of four routes ship at perfect Lighthouse 100/100/100/100, /deck/[slug] at 167 B First Load JS thanks to pure server-rendered slide preview. See the case study at docs/case-studies/narrative-generator.md for architecture, key decisions, and three engineering moments (Vercel CLI rootDirectory workaround, Lighthouse a11y regression caught + fixed, 14.2 kB → 167 B bundle reduction).
